result.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
result.summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on HunyuanVideo-13B with equally weighted visual and motion quality rewards, DiffusionART reaches the late-stage mean reward levels of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 12.02 and 11.72 times fewer GPU hours, respectively, while achieving 28.8% and 53.0% higher mean training rewards.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DiffusionART，将每个 prompt 的奖励聚合为共享的奖励改进方向以更新反向过程状态，从而在构造上去除 NFT 类目标隐含的前向-反向一致性力，并加入信赖域掩码的二次更新实现免 EMA 漂移恢复，用于扩散模型在线 RL 微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽面向图像/视频生成、不直接研究 VLM 推理，但其跨去噪步的奖励聚合与信用分配、以及无 EMA 的稳定性/漂移控制机制，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索。
